title: trio-sdk-lightweight-token-router-and-pullstream-shim
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: SDKs have continued to drift in how they choose and refresh credentials and in how pull-style streaming APIs are consumed by application code. This PR introduces a compact, language-agnostic token router plus a tiny pullstream shim to bring ergonomics and parity across Python/TypeScript/Go without forcing large surface API changes. What this does: (1) adds a lightweight TokenRouter abstraction that centralizes credential selection logic, precedence rules, and a small lease/refresh hint API so SDKs can implement identical fallback behavior and telemetry hooks; (2) introduces PullstreamShim helpers for each SDK to normalize async/pull streaming semantics and provide a simple resume/cancel contract for callers; (3) updates the SDKs to use the router/shim in the default client path with a feature flag to preserve backwards compatibility during rollout; (4) includes tests, end-to-end smoke harness updates, and example snippets for each language; (5) bumps package versions: python->0.18.0, typescript->1.12.0, go->1.8.3. Backwards compatibility: router is additive and initially off behind feature flag "sdk.token_router_v1"; existing credential env vars and explicit credential objects continue to work. Migration notes: clients can opt-in by setting feature flag or by passing TokenRouter to Client() constructors; applications using bespoke streaming helpers will see minimal API differences and are provided an adapter in sdk/examples/compat. Tests & CI: added unit tests for router precedence and simulated lease expiry, integration test that spins up a token mock and validates cross-language resume behavior. Telemetry: emits lightweight metric labels (sdk.token_selection, sdk.stream_resume_reason) and logs on refresh failures. Release notes: see release_notes field. Linked work: ENG-1987 standardize client-side credential precedence; ENG-2034 streaming ergonomics parity. Checklist: ensure feature flag rollout coordinated with server-side token-lease endpoints, confirm package registry artifacts for three SDKs, announce migration in SDK changelogs and upgrade guide.
commits: feat(auth): introduce TokenRouter interface and core implementation
feat(stream): add PullstreamShim helpers for py/ts/go and compatibility adapters
chore(sdk): wire TokenRouter into default client with feature flag
test: add unit and integration tests for token selection and resume paths
review_thread: Luis Ortega: Nice consolidation. Two asks: a) can we avoid exposing lease internals in public headers and b) add a short changelog snippet explaining fallback semantics?

Maya Chen: Responded that lease hint is intentionally minimal (expiry + approx ttl) and we've kept it out of public surface except in TokenRouterHint struct which is marked experimental; added changelog blurb in docs/ and extra unit test for precedence.
Priya Kapoor: CI flakiness on Go integration initially; test harness missed context cancellation path. Please add context timeouts to the integration harness.
Maya Chen: Added context timeouts and re-ran CI. Go integration stabilized on the second run.
Samir Patel: Approved after verifying telemetry labels and that feature flag gating is correct for existing clients. Left one minor nit inline about a log message level.
release_notes: Add TokenRouter abstraction and PullstreamShim to unify credential selection and pull-style streaming across SDKs. Feature-gated rollout; non-breaking by default. Bumped versions: python 0.18.0, typescript 1.12.0, go 1.8.3. Telemetry: sdk.token_selection and sdk.stream_resume_reason labels added. See docs/sdk/token-router-and-pullstream.md for migration details.
notes_for_ops: Coordinate feature flag rollout with platform token-lease endpoint deployment. Monitor new telemetry tags for unexpected increases in refresh failures. If regressions observed, flip feature flag off to revert to previous behavior.
